# Glossary

Everything below is read out of the package at build time. If a term is
here it is in the code, and if it is in the code it is here.

## Unit suffixes

Every number crossing a public boundary carries one of these in its name.
`check_units` enforces it.

| Suffix   | Means                                   |
| -------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `_cyc`   | cycles                                  |
| `_day`   | days                                    |
| `_deg`   | degrees                                 |
| `_degf`  | degrees fahrenheit                      |
| `_frac`  | fraction, 0 to 1                        |
| `_ft`    | feet                                    |
| `_hz`    | hertz                                   |
| `_in`    | inches                                  |
| `_in2`   | square inches                           |
| `_in3`   | cubic inches, section modulus           |
| `_in4`   | inches to the fourth, moment of inertia |
| `_kip`   | kips, thousands of pounds force         |
| `_kipft` | kip feet                                |
| `_kipin` | kip inches                              |
| `_klf`   | kips per linear foot                    |
| `_ksi`   | kips per square inch                    |
| `_mi`    | miles                                   |
| `_pct`   | percent, 0 to 100                       |
| `_s`     | seconds                                 |
| `_ue`    | microstrain, parts per million          |
| `_yr`    | years                                   |

## Fatigue detail categories

AASHTO LRFD Table 6.6.1.2.5-1. The detail constant sets the sloping part
of the S-N curve; the threshold is the constant amplitude fatigue limit.

| Category | Detail constant | Threshold, ksi | Example                                          |
| -------- | --------------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| A        | 250 x 10^8      | 24             | plain rolled or cleaned surface, no attachment   |
| B        | 120 x 10^8      | 16             | full penetration groove weld ground flush        |
| B'       | 61 x 10^8       | 12             | longitudinal fillet welded built up member       |
| C        | 44 x 10^8       | 10             | transverse stiffener weld to flange or web       |
| C'       | 44 x 10^8       | 12             | transverse stiffener weld, base metal at the toe |
| D        | 22 x 10^8       | 7              | attachment between two and four inches long      |
| E        | 11 x 10^8       | 4.5            | cover plate end on a flange under an inch thick  |
| E'       | 3.9 x 10^8      | 2.6            | cover plate end on a thicker flange, no end weld |

## Vehicles

The catalogue a rating draws on. Design vehicles are for a design check,
legal and hauling vehicles decide a posting, and emergency vehicles are
rated separately because failing one is a conversation rather than a sign.
